tree_integrity.algorithm: sha256 over every regular file recursively under simulator/, sorted by POSIX relative path; for each file hash UTF-8(relative_path), NUL, ASCII(decimal_byte_length), NUL, then raw file bytes

public_api.purpose: Import-safe Python lifecycle for raw physical worlds or TaskPacks, typed semantic actions and observations, process isolation, and local or remote attachment

task_catalog.purpose: Discovery, preparation-mode metadata, strict validation, and hash-verified loading of bundled or user-authored structured TaskPacks

physical_world.purpose: Isaac scene construction, locomotion, manipulation, rendering, and physical predicates

environment.purpose: Persistent environment lifecycle, deterministic reset, command execution, observation, and native state score

interaction.purpose: Assistant/Human turn protocol, TaskPack completion contract, and episode audit trace

transport.purpose: Persistent local or remote protocol with raw-world and TaskPack lifecycle operations

taskpack_support.purpose: Lossless conversion of frozen bts/1.0 executable specifications

world_catalog.purpose: Frozen BEHAVIOR scene admission and container vocabulary

human_model.purpose: SMPL+H body/hand runtime bridge; licensed model, motion, and grasp data are explicit external dependencies

benchmark_runner.purpose: One-command task selection, independent Human and Assistant model endpoints, deterministic multi-GPU sharding, reporting, evidence adjudication, and optional post-run video
